title: nearest-villager
description: Nearest Villager Job: Automatically assigns workstations to the closest villager and lets you highlight owners with a sneak-right-click. Optimized for Paper/Spigot 1.21.1+.
body:
# 🏘️ Nearest Villager Job

**Ensure the right villager gets the job – every single time.**

Are you tired of placing a workstation only to have a villager 50 blocks away claim it while the one standing right next to it stays unemployed?

**Nearest Villager Job** fixes Minecraft’s inconsistent profession assignment by always selecting the **closest eligible villager**.

---

## 🌟 Key Features

### 🧠 Smart Workstation Assignment
- Automatically scans a **32-block radius** when placing a workstation  
- Assigns the job to the **nearest unemployed adult villager**  
- Works with all standard stations (Lectern, Composter, Barrel, etc.)  

---

### ✨ Workstation Highlighter (Sneak-Click)
- **Shift + Right-Click** any workstation  
- The linked villager will **glow for 3 seconds**  
- Perfect for debugging and organizing trading halls  

---

### ⚡ Lightweight & Safe
- Built on the official **Paper / Spigot API**  
- Fully compatible with vanilla villager mechanics  
- No world corruption, no AI conflicts  

---

### ⚙️ Fully Configurable
- Simple `config.yml`  
- Toggle features or adjust timings to your liking  

---

## 🛠️ Configuration

```yaml
# Enable or disable the sneak-click glowing feature
sneak-click-glowing: true

# Duration of the glowing effect in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second)
glowing-duration-ticks: 60
